purpose: Canonical semantic terrain contract for editor exposure, biome palettes, LPC atlas baking, generated terrain rules, and terrain completion validation.

paintModes.advanced: Editor-visible only with an advanced/generated badge or advanced filter.
paintModes.generated: Created by terrain normalization, worldgen, or gameplay systems rather than ordinary free painting.
paintModes.deferred: Reserved for later scene/object/gameplay systems and not part of overworld terrain completion.

statuses.production: Safe default material or direct brush.
statuses.preview: Visible/usable with known incomplete topology or pair coverage.
statuses.incomplete: Known semantic material, but missing required topology, pair coverage, or editor treatment.
statuses.deferred: Explicitly out of current terrain pass scope.

detailVariationPercent.description: Disabled for non-grass terrain fills. Only audited complete single-cell grass accents may vary; larger source details are atomic stamps.

rareDetailPercent.description: Disabled in terrain fill selection. Forage, dig spots, rocks, and authored multi-cell details are separate object/stamp spawn systems.

materials.label: Grass
materials.notes: Primary overworld base ground; supports deterministic detail variants.

materials.label: Tall Grass
materials.notes: Currently maps visually through Grass_Dark; long-term should be either a ground variant or vegetation overlay.

materials.label: Dirt
materials.notes: Primary earth material.

materials.label: Sand
materials.notes: Primary dry beach/desert material; wet-sand edge should be generated when adjacent to water.

materials.label: Wet Sand
materials.notes: Retired from active generation and editor palettes. Legacy saves migrate to V7 Sand; coastlines transition directly into V7 Water_Shallows_Sand.

materials.label: Gravel
materials.notes: General walkable Gravel ground. It may be used along shores, but does not imply shoreline semantics. Missing direct V7 pairs use reviewed V7-only connector tuples while the Gravel owner fill remains unchanged.

materials.label: Shore Foam
materials.notes: Legacy visual-only alias. Hidden from active V7 terrain painting; V7 Water_Shallows_Sand supplies the authored ocean edge.

materials.label: Mud
materials.notes: General walkable Mud ground. Watered tilled soil is a separate farming state. Missing direct V7 pairs use reviewed V7-only connector tuples.

materials.label: Road
materials.notes: General dirt/tan travel path.

materials.label: Stone Path
materials.notes: Should be constructed path stone; must separate from Pebble Shore.

materials.label: Mountain Path
materials.notes: Needs missing pair coverage against sand/dirt/grass. Active certification source lane: V7 only; hidden from ElizaWy style palettes.

materials.label: Bridge
materials.notes: Should eventually be object/stamp or structural path with placement rules over water.

materials.label: Water
materials.notes: Generic water; should normalize into shallow/deep bands where appropriate.

materials.label: Shallow Water
materials.notes: Required gameplay border between land/shore and deep water. V7 Water_Shallows_Dirt transitions through exact V7 tuples; no generated foam or cross-style depth overlay.

materials.label: Deep Water
materials.notes: Deep water interior; must not touch land directly.

materials.label: River Water
materials.notes: Generated/advanced river channel material.

materials.label: River Mouth Blend
materials.notes: Generated where river water meets ocean/lake/shore.

materials.label: Ocean Shallow
materials.notes: Generated coastal ocean band. Renders through terrain-v7 Water so it can transition cleanly into Water_Deep.

materials.label: Ocean Deep
materials.notes: Generated open-ocean interior.

materials.label: Cliff
materials.notes: Structural cliff topology; explicitly not ground-corner mapped.

materials.label: Rock Ground
materials.notes: Walkable natural Rock Ground backed by V7 Rock_Dark. Vertical cliffs are derived from elevation and use a separate structural provider.

materials.label: Cave Floor
materials.notes: Cave ground fill; needs cave-specific variants and transitions. Active certification source lane: V7 only; hidden from ElizaWy style palettes.

materials.label: Cave Wall
materials.notes: Cave wall family; not part of generic ground blending.

materials.label: Wall
materials.notes: Building/interior wall family.

materials.label: Wood Floor
materials.notes: Interior/built floor.

materials.label: Plank Floor
materials.notes: Interior/built floor.

materials.label: Stone Floor
materials.notes: Interior/dungeon floor.

materials.label: Brick Floor
materials.notes: Interior/town floor.

materials.label: Tilled Soil
materials.notes: Farm plot base.

materials.label: Watered Tilled Soil
materials.notes: Created only by watering a TilledSoil gameplay cell; not exposed as a direct terrain brush.

materials.label: Crop Seedling
materials.notes: Gameplay crop state, not ordinary terrain painting.

materials.label: Greenhouse Zone
materials.notes: Not overworld terrain. Greenhouse stamp should transition into a greenhouse interior scene.
